recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. Reintroducing AdverseEvent.context or adding EpisodeOfCare directly to AdverseEvent.encounter would reverse later published Patient Care workflow decisions; future EpisodeOfCare changes should be handled as a new decision and, if extension-scoped, in the Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-14458 was a Published / Persuasive with Modification Patient Care request to add AdverseEvent.context 0..1 Reference(EpisodeOfCare|Encounter), defined as the encounter or episode of care establishing the context for the AdverseEvent, with a usage note distinguishing the event encounter from a later reporting encounter.
initial_application: Commit 1051f7d9e92921d517519953657b5f739b0ed15a added AdverseEvent.context with Reference(Encounter|EpisodeOfCare), the requested definition/comment, and GF#14458 in the then-authoritative AdverseEvent spreadsheet source.
additional_context: FHIR-19511 later changed Patient Care context elements, including AdverseEvent, to encounter 0..1 Reference(Encounter) and directed EpisodeOfCare support to workflow-episodeOfCare extension semantics. FHIR-25397 later clarified AdverseEvent.encounter wording to the encounter associated with the start of the AdverseEvent while preserving the seed's second-encounter usage distinction. Existing combined-branch audits already represent FHIR-19511 and FHIR-25397.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current core source has active AdverseEvent.encounter 0..1 Reference(Encounter), cites GF#14458; FHIR-25397, and retains the event-encounter guidance. The Extension Pack workflow-episodeOfCare extension includes AdverseEvent context with Reference(EpisodeOfCare), so the EpisodeOfCare part is represented outside the core AdverseEvent element as later directed.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Patient Care context elements, including AdverseEvent.context, to encounter and moved EpisodeOfCare support to workflow-episodeOfCare extension semantics.
Clarified AdverseEvent.encounter short/definition/comment while preserving the event-encounter versus later-reporting-encounter distinction.
